title: IceCache: Memory-Efficient Semantic KV-Cache for Long LLMs
summary: IceCache reorganizes the KV-cache using semantic token clustering and hierarchical indexing to optimize long-context LLM inference. By selectively loading relevant cache pages from CPU to GPU, it maintains high accuracy with a drastically reduced GPU memory footprint.
research_notes: Achieves 99% accuracy on LongBench benchmarks while using only 256 tokens in the active GPU cache.

evolution.summary: Presented at ICLR 2026, IceCache represents the current frontier in semantic-aware KV-cache management. It extends the PagedAttention concept by adding a DCI-tree based hierarchical index for query-aware token retrieval.
